title: Ultra Dense Basque French Cheddar Galette
description: A rich and decadent galette that showcases the flavors of mature cheddar cheese, perfect for special occasions or as a show-stopping appetizer. This dish is a unique fusion of Basque and French cuisines, with a dense and flaky crust, a creamy cheese filling, and a hint of caramelized onions.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread the caramelized onions evenly over the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Crumble the mature cheddar cheese over the onions.
If using Gruyère cheese, sprinkle it over the cheddar cheese.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the egg wash over the crust to give it a golden brown color.
Bake the galette for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the galette from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
